claims.statement: The observed native Codex and Herdr processes run in the host mount namespace. Existing host root orchestration is an actual execution path.
The deployment README defines a dedicated non-root SSH/Herdr/Codex user runtime and describes a container-centered remote Orchestrator entrypoint.
The user wants one integrated Orchestrator workflow across Codex, Claude, Grok, Muse, Antigravity and native Hermes TUI, preserving host and container environments with purpose boundaries.

The main problem is an ungoverned gap among declared entrypoint, current host-centered operation, execution placement, workspace provenance and native session ownership; absence of an original design is not established.
Host /home/palantirkc and container /home/palantirkc have different backing directories and accounts. The container home binds host /docker/herdr-runtime/home, not host /home/palantirkc.
Healthy means SSH bootstrap readiness; cold readiness with no Herdr daemon is allowed. Container health alone does not verify agent use, hooks, serving or Goal recovery.

The infrastructure thread reports inherited HERDR_PANE_ID w3:p1; a previous native pane lookup returned pane_not_found. This is evidence of stale context, not proof that all hooks fail. The container helper explicitly launches codex --no-daemon to retain pane context.

Palantir describes Ontology as operational integration of data, logic, action and security, including real objects/links, executable behavior and governed state change. A folder taxonomy or ID table alone is insufficient.

This proposal does not establish that the local common harness implements the full Palantir product or currently enforces every proposed action policy. Existing semantic owners and native executors must be inspected before extension.

The runtime compose_files label includes stdin overlay input and the compose image label differs from the live immutable image ID. Reconcile original deployment receipts before rebuild; these observations alone do not establish corruption or drift.
A shared UID1000 and whole-home RW bind do not establish task-to-task or project-to-project filesystem isolation. Task-bound instructions must not be reported as an OS-enforced per-task sandbox.

problems.failureMode: An agent chooses execution environment from shell inheritance, alias or folder name rather than a Task-bound role and capability contract.
problems.impact: Wrong permissions, duplicate setup, unclear handoff and uncertain operational ownership.

problems.failureMode: Same project/path names are treated as the same repository or current revision.
problems.impact: Edits or tests run against an unintended checkout; source consolidation can retire a still-used path.

problems.failureMode: Pane identity, native thread, Goal and running-server identity are conflated, or inherited daemon context is assumed fresh.
problems.impact: Hook/session restore/control may address the wrong pane, or readiness may be mistaken for continued work.

problems.failureMode: Typed IDs/relations are counted as permission enforcement or completed runtime adoption.
problems.impact: The recorded architecture and real effects can diverge even when documents validate.

problems.failureMode: One YAML, image tag or healthy status is treated as a complete reproducible execution or recovery contract.
problems.impact: Rebuild/restart loses unrecorded overlay or state and creates false recovery expectations.

problems.failureMode: A Task metadata scope is mistaken for filesystem enforcement, or testing an excluded host path is treated as proof that sibling projects are isolated.
problems.impact: Agents with the same user/home can have broader access than a proposed Task action policy describes.

palantirAlignment.interpretation: Use the operational model of data, logic, actions and security as the design basis, rather than a folder taxonomy or ID inventory.
palantirAlignment.admissionRule: Reuse existing owner concepts before adding a type; candidate names in this draft are not a parallel Ontology implementation.
palantirAlignment.logicRole: Existing typed policies resolve allowed runtime, required source revision and preconditions; native owners continue to execute loops, tools, sessions and retries.
palantirAlignment.enforcementRule: An Ontology policy record must be bound to actual UID, mount, socket, credential scope, native approval and supported target helper; a relation alone grants no permission.
palantirAlignment.transactionLimit: Git, Docker and native session effects are not one atomic cross-system transaction. Preserve separate native receipts, currentness checks and bounded recovery.

nativeRuntimeContracts.commonCliContract: Use common command names and explicit native capabilities per runtime/user; do not force one absolute /root path into non-root container environments.
nativeRuntimeContracts.accountsAndAuthentication: Separate native user settings/session/authentication by runtime and owner; do not copy host credentials as a shortcut.
nativeRuntimeContracts.herdrControl: Native Herdr multi-machine/server identities remain distinct. A host-visible remote TUI does not prove hook/socket/resume integration across the boundary.
nativeRuntimeContracts.codexLaunch: Review the documented --no-daemon helper versus shared daemon capabilities, remote mode and queue/agents requirements. Choose explicit native semantics; do not assume the generic command inherits helper flags.
nativeRuntimeContracts.currentSessionContinuity: Do not move directories, change mounts or restart a runtime underneath an active native session. Use checkpoints and verified source/runtime adoption.
nativeRuntimeContracts.codeServer: Retain its separate browser IDE role and privileges; current YAML existence alone does not establish a running service.

answers.question: 앞으로 Herdr와 Codex·Claude 같은 작업용 CLI를 주로 어디에서 실행하고 싶으세요?
answers.verbatimAnswer: 목적별로 둘 다 유지하되 역할을 명확히 분리
answers.interpretation: Retain host and container environments with explicit purposes. This does not choose a specific physical placement contract.

answers.question: 현재 herdr-runtime 컨테이너가 꼭 필요한 이유로 생각하시는 것은 무엇인가요?
answers.verbatimAnswer: VPS Host의 Orchestrator가 Codex/Claude/Grok/Muse/Antigravity CLI를 필요한 경우 agnostic하게 사용하면서 Hermes-agent-2q3y/ 컨테이너에서 Hermes TUI도 사용하면서 pane별로 TUI를 띄워놓고, 사용자가 원하는 프로젝트들을 개발하도록 하기 위함이었다. 그러나 최근에 VPS Host 실행환경에서 Orchestrator를 사용하면서 역할이 불분명해졌는데(왜냐하면 VPS Host Herdr Orchestrator Session가 pane으로 Codex/Claude/Grok/Muse/Antigravity/Hermes 를 모두 띄울 수 있으니까), 역할정의를 다시 했으면 좋겠는데? 컨테이너의 역할이 헷갈려.
answers.interpretation: The integrated multi-CLI and native Hermes development workflow is the intended outcome. Host pane visibility alone does not specify where every worker process must execute.

answers.question: 두 환경을 유지할 때 역할 경계는 어느 쪽이 좋을까요?
answers.verbatimAnswer: 1번인데, 인프라의 boundary가 어느정도인지 모르겠는데? 내가 Palantir's AIP/Foundry같은 소프트웨어의 근간이 되는 **"Palantir에서 의미하는(매우 중요한 형용사) Ontology"**를 기반으로 컨테이너들을 분리해서 개발 전반에 대한 작업하고싶다.
answers.interpretation: The user selected host-infrastructure/container-development direction while explicitly requesting the boundary definition. Palantir-style operational Ontology is a governing design requirement; this is not approval of every implementation detail of a prior option.

answers.question: 호스트와 컨테이너의 프로젝트 파일은 어떻게 다루고 싶으세요?
answers.interpretation: Compare shared bind-mounted workspaces against separate Git workspaces. No storage migration choice is accepted.

answers.question: herdr-runtime은 어떤 역할이 가장 유용할까요?
answers.verbatimAnswer: 통합적으로 고려해서 너가 제안을 해봐. 내가 Whole-Lens가 아니라서 잘 모르겠어.
answers.interpretation: The assistant should synthesize the architecture recommendation rather than require the user to choose infrastructure abstractions. Proposal selection remains distinct from migration authorization.

answers.verbatimAnswer: 이와 관련해서도 디렉토리 트리 관련해서 최적화(예를들어, hermes-profile-* 전부 필요없어, 예전에 Git 설정 잘못해서 전부 통합해야하고 repo도 대규모 개편해야하는 이유 중에 하나(다른 이유들도 많음)가 이거야)해야하니까, 새 Orchestrator가 공통하네스에 근거하여 ID 부여하고 작업범위 추가포함하도록 해라.
answers.interpretation: Consolidate unnecessary hermes-profile-* source repositories within broader repository reorganization. Historical Git misconfiguration is one stated reason. Runtime Hermes profiles/data are distinct resources whose migration/deletion is not inferred.

answers.verbatimAnswer: 너는 아까 실행환경에서 디렉토리 트리 자세히 출력해서 나에게 설명했던 것을 기반으로 more deep dive 해서, VPS Host 실행환경과 herdr-runtime/ 컨테이너의 역할이 불분명한 것에 대한 문제를 정의하고, 이에 대해서 새 Orchestrator가 작업을 시작할 때 그쪽에 전달할 수 있는 제안서(ID를 새로 또 부여하거나 기존 작업범위를 더 넓혀서 진행할 수 있도록)를 만들자. 이와 관련해서 유저 인터뷰 하면서 적극적으로 너의 의견을 제안해라.
